CustomField.description: Fundraising Quick Start: audit + trigger flag for the placeholder OutreachSourceCode ("Create First OSC") auto-created on Tactical-level Campaigns (FQS_Hierarchy_Depth__c >= 3). Set to true by FQS_CampaignHierarchyBuilder after the Ask inserts. If flipped from false to true manually, the FQS_Campaign_Create_First_OSC record-triggered flow creates the placeholder. Idempotent via External_Id__c = 'FQS-OSC-{CampaignId15}-DEFAULT' — flow no-ops if a placeholder already exists.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates the "Create First OSC" placeholder has been auto-provisioned. Set automatically by hierarchy builder; can be checked manually to (re)create the placeholder on a Tactical-level campaign. Idempotent — safe to re-check.
CustomField.label: Create First Outreach Source Code
